CustomField.description: Command Center logic, Coaching list card: true when Health Category is Off Track or Needs Attention, or CC: Dropped since last score is true, or CC: Commit backing is Not backed.
CustomField.formula: OR(CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Off Track"), CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Needs Attention"), PH_CC_Dropped__c, PH_CC_Commit_Backing__c = "Not backed (under 70%)")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Command Center: Coaching list. Off track, needs attention, dropped since last score, or Commit not backed.
CustomField.label: CC: Needs attention
